What happens next

From confirmation to event day.

We will keep you informed at every step.

  1. 1

    Confirm all three speakers

    Asadullah is confirmed. We confirm the third, then tell you.

    AIM: BY NEXT WEEK
  2. 2

    Ask for your best time

    We ask each speaker separately which time suits them best.

  3. 3

    Confirm the event time

    With the best times in, we fix the date and time for everyone.

  4. 4

    Online rehearsal

    A short online session to run through the panel together.

  5. 5

    Speaker handbook

    How to get to Nottingham, the event flow, the event questions, where to park and more.

  6. 6

    Event day

    The panel talk, then your gift and dinner.
